DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypothyroidism (with incidental finding of Alzheimer's disease on prior PET scan). 

The triad of fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance is classic for hypothyroidism, and the hoarseness likely results from myxedema affecting the laryngeal nerves. The normal bowel habits and lack of sweating changes help rule out other endocrine disorders, while the Alzheimer's finding is unrelated to your current acute symptoms. I will start you on levothyroxine and monitor your TSH and Free T4 levels.
